notes: Cases DIR-CLOSED-01..09 of PV-REV-DIRECTION-CLOSED-TARGET-001 and DIR-INCOMPLETE-01..16 of PV-DIRECTION-INCOMPLETE-001 (accepted by PV-REV-DIRECTION-INCOMPLETE-001), transcribed from the contracts' required fixtures and adopted in 0.2.0 as one Direction rule version, direction.bands.v2. Cases about per-change evidence state the change-request and target inventories and run the derivation (given.derive), so the state-neutral linkage and the LINKED/UNLINKED/UNRESOLVED reduction are executed where they happen; cases about the completion rule itself state the N/L/U/R counts. A reference's state is what its resolution established: OPEN or CLOSED when the declared target resolves, MISSING when a complete register positively lacks the id, anything else unresolved.

vectors.title: an active change request with an explicit link to an open target is linked
the same change request and target id stay linked when the target moves from open to closed; the linkage share is unchanged
a link to a closed target is linked when the target identity resolves authoritatively

variants.title: milestone embedded in the change request

vectors.title: a reference to a target the complete register positively lacks is unlinked with the missing-reference diagnostic; linkage is never fabricated
vectors.notes: The judgement's 'unlinked or unresolved' was narrowed by PV-REV-DIRECTION-INCOMPLETE-001: a positively missing id is UNLINKED (this case, DIR-INCOMPLETE-07); an id nobody could resolve is UNRESOLVED (DIR-INCOMPLETE-08, -09). Neither is ever linked.

vectors.title: closing a target cannot by itself worsen the Direction band
vectors.notes: Under direction.bands.v1.1 the closed variant counted 0 of 3 linked and was SCATTERED: calibration finding 9.

vectors.title: reopening a target cannot by itself improve the Direction band
Horizon's open-target counts still exclude the closed target a change request stays linked to, so the two Vitals may diverge
vectors.notes: The same evidence is FULLY_LINKED for Direction (DIR-CLOSED-03): Direction traces work to declared targets, Horizon counts what is still open.

vectors.title: every active change request linked to one closed target is FULLY_LINKED with the single-target diagnostic: traceability, not alignment
adopting the repair changes the Direction rule id: the first comparison across it is INCOMPARABLE for Direction alone, while an unaffected Vital still compares
N=5, L=0, U=3, R=2: every completion k in {0,1,2} is SCATTERED
N=5, L=3, U=1, R=1: every completion k in {3,4} is MIXED
N=4, L=2, U=0, R=2: completions reach MIXED and FULLY_LINKED, so no band
N=5, L=1, U=1, R=3: completions reach SCATTERED and MIXED, so no band
N=1, L=0, U=0, R=1: completions reach SCATTERED and FULLY_LINKED; never DEGRADED FULLY_LINKED
a marker to an authoritatively resolved closed target is LINKED; closing or reopening the target alone does not change the linkage
a marker to T that a complete authoritative lookup proves absent is UNLINKED: N=1, L=0, U=1, R=0 is exactly SCATTERED with the missing-reference diagnostic
a marker to T while the target list is PARTIAL and T is not in the observed subset, with no direct lookup, is UNRESOLVED: no band
vectors.notes: The incomplete target list still proves the planning capability (a returned target exists), so Direction reaches the completion rule; absence from the partial list is never deletion proof.

vectors.title: a marker whose target resolution is unavailable, forbidden, unknown, errored or stale is UNRESOLVED, never LINKED by fallback
a PARTIAL global target enumeration does not degrade Direction when every referenced target is resolved on its own
vectors.notes: Targets 7 and 3 are resolved by the milestones embedded in the change requests, not by the capped target list; Horizon over the same evidence stays incomplete (HOR-PARTIAL-08).

vectors.title: partial link evidence leaves two change requests unresolved, but N/L/U/R forces SCATTERED for every completion
partial link evidence admits MIXED and FULLY_LINKED, so no band
linkage capability that is neither positively present nor absent is UNKNOWN with no band
an active-change inventory that is PARTIAL leaves N unproven: UNKNOWN with no band
reversed and reshuffled enumeration, page boundaries, marker order and target order leave L/U/R, the reachable bands, the status, the band and the diagnostics unchanged
several active change requests all linked to one authoritatively resolved closed target, with complete evidence, are exactly FULLY_LINKED: neutral, no concentration threshold
